title: Creating Custom Exceptions
learning_outcomes: Explain the purpose of creating custom exceptions and identify when it is appropriate in a Java program.
Apply at least one of the lesson topics—extending exception classes—in a small, readable example.
Predict the example result and check it against the stated output or a boundary-case test.

content.intro: In this lesson, you will study creating custom exceptions with a short explanation, an original visual map, a Java example, and a check you can perform yourself. Focus on the relationship between the rule and the behavior rather than memorizing isolated syntax.
content.why_it_matters: This concept matters because it helps you report and recover from expected failures while ensuring resources are released. In this lesson, focus on extending exception classes and use a minimal example to check what the rule actually guarantees.

content_blocks.title: The core idea
content_blocks.text: A class defines state and behavior; an object is an instance. Encapsulation protects invariants by keeping mutable state private and validating updates through a small public API. The important habit is to make the assumptions explicit and use the code example as a small experiment.

content_blocks.title: How the pieces fit
content_blocks.text: Connect extending exception classes with constructor design before choosing an implementation. The example is a small, observable case; extend it by changing one input and checking a boundary, invalid value, or compatibility limit where relevant.

items.text: Use Path and Files for modern file operations, choose byte or character APIs based on the data, and close resources reliably. Parse external files defensively because their contents may be incomplete or malformed.

items.title: Domain-specific exceptions
items.text: Exceptions report conditions that interrupt the normal path. Catch only when the code can recover or add context, preserve the original cause, and use try-with-resources for closeable resources.

content_blocks.title: Professional habit
content_blocks.text: Keep one clear hypothesis per experiment. Check the version, read the error message, test boundaries, and record what evidence supports your conclusion.
